summary: Every instruction takes a decode cycle and a commit cycle, controlled by a one-bit phase register. Program-level results are identical; every program takes twice as many cycles. Included as a positive control for the measurement pipeline.
changes: CPU.hdl: DFF phase register; A, D, M writes and PC updates gated by phase = 1
limitations: Not cycle-compatible with the Hack CPU specification: cycle-exact official tests (CPU.tst, Computer*.tst) fail by design.
A real two-cycle design would usually allow a shorter clock period; the simulator cannot show that, so only the cycle-count cost is visible.
